text:
maya: Morning — quick handoff from my shift. Queue ~34 (up 8 since last check). No new P1s. Two recurring clusters: payments webhook retries (INC-459) and embeddings slow for long texts. I drafted a billing macro update below and left notes in the triage doc.
sam: grabbing INC-459 now. saw `HTTP 503 -> retry limit reached` in logs. pinging @eng-oncall (jeremy) in case rate-limiter needs a bump :eyes:
jeremy: on it — will check rate limits and the webhook router config. If we need immediate relief we can toggle the `payment-webhook-burst` route to Dedicated for ~30m. keep me posted.
liam: merged macro PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/support-macros/pulls/12 — main change is adding a forced `resend_event` step and an escalate template. renamed macro to "billing-resend-and-escalate".
nina: thanks — pushed a small tweak to include KMS troubleshooting steps (expired key checks). flagged TKT-871 and TKT-873 as needing account owners; assigning TKT-871 to @sam.
sam: ack — taking TKT-871. leaving a note on TKT-873 for the account team. pinged infra to look at KMS rotation logs.
ops-bot: Deploy succeeded: support-macros v1.3.1 rolled out to prod. Monitoring enabled. :white_check_mark:
maya: blockers: embeddings pipeline is timing out on >=12k chars. short-term mitigation is to chunk + stitch. I'll add an "embedding-chunking" macro example to triage notes.
jeremy: plan for embeddings — infra will enable transient truncation at edge tomorrow 12:00 UTC; we can canary for 1 hour. I'll write a short runbook and post it here once ready.
sam: anything else before I close handoff? maya — you want me to keep monitoring webhooks after your shift? :thumbsup:
maya: that's it from me. left the handoff notes in the shared triage doc and added a quick resend helper snippet:
```
# resend helper
curl -X POST https://internal.api/support/resend_event \\n  -d '{"ticket_id":"TKT-871","reason":"webhook retry"}'
```
liam: thanks — I'll take evening coverage and escalate if a P1 appears. :coffee:
